description:
**Blocked by d06.2. Read deck §6 "Layout & composition" before
starting. d06.12 (VText helpers) is parallel — if it hasn't
landed, use `%VText{}` structs directly here and let d06.12
collapse the call sites later.**

Two layout primitives (`Box`, `Container`) collapse into VBox/VFlow
and disappear as modules — their padding/border math moves into
`OctoPi.TUI.VDom.Paint` (already there from d06.1, see border_top/
build_padding_lines patterns the painter must implement). Four
content composites (`BashExecution`, `ToolExecution`, `Diff`,
`UserMessage`) become functional components.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/box.ex` (~145 lines).
  Border + padding + bg_fn + title. Painter MUST cover all of
  this; if d06.1's VBox doesn't, file a defect on d06.1.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/container.ex`
  (~50 lines). Trivial — just a children list. Becomes %VFlow{}.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/bash_execution.ex`
  (~150 lines). Streaming entry: status (running/complete/cancelled/
  error), output_lines, expanded. Today implements
  `update/finalize` callbacks. Hook-cell holds the running state;
  status transitions arrive as `handle_event` payloads.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tool_execution.ex`
  (~285 lines). Largest of the four. Status, args summary, output
  preview. Same pattern as bash_execution.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/diff.ex`
  (~145 lines). Static — accepts a structured diff and emits
  colored +/- lines.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/user_message.ex`
  (~65 lines). Static — wraps user input in styled box.
- All tests under `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/`
  for these.

**Target shape:**
- `Box` and `Container` modules deleted. Callers use VBox/VFlow
  directly. Update every callsite (likely 5-15 locations across
  the components and Interactive).
- BashExecution/ToolExecution: functional components. Hook-cell
  holds %ExecutionState{output_lines, status, exit_code,
  expanded}; reconciler routes `{:bash_chunk, id, bytes}` and
  `{:bash_done, id, exit_code}` events to the corresponding hole
  via `handle_event`. The component reads its current state from
  the hook cell and emits a VBox of styled output.
- Diff/UserMessage: pure render fns; props carry the data; no
  hooks needed.
- Streaming entries: the `update/2` and `finalize/2` callbacks
  on these modules go away. Replaced by `handle_event`-driven
  hook-cell mutation.
- Memoize at the component root with `use_memo` keyed on
  `{snapshot_identity, theme.id, ctx.width}` so re-renders are
  cache-hits when nothing changed.

**Acceptance:**
- Per-component tests stay green (find via
  `ls apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/`).
- `Components.Box` and `Components.Container` modules deleted;
  no remaining `import` or `alias` references in the codebase
  (`grep -rn "Components.Box\\|Components.Container" apps/octo_pi_tui`
  returns 0 lines outside the deletion commit).
- Streaming smoke (tmux): run a prompt that triggers a long
  `bash` and `view_file` tool call; confirm output streams
  smoothly with no flicker; expand/collapse with the relevant
  hotkey works.
- Hook-cell snapshot churn telemetry confirms exactly one
  `set_state` call per `:bash_chunk` event (no over-firing).
title: Convert composites: Box, Container, BashExecution, ToolExecution, Diff, UserMessage
